limitations: Actual post-clipping wheel angle/force and per-step ego physical states were not recorded; SI action mapping cannot be certified from normalized commands alone.
Per-step collision/offroad/success flags were not archived; first accident time cannot be reconstructed from episode-level flags.
No independent traffic-stream repeats; replay seed is not a new independent map.
H2/H4/H10 exist only for six pilot maps. H1 has twelve development and six previously exposed validation maps.
The prior validation maps are now seen data for attribution, never a fresh independent validation set.
actual_continuation_return in old branch JSON means RTG after the first step, including remaining forced actions when H>1; the index distinguishes both continuation definitions.

normalized_action_mapping_scope.recorded_execution_scope: The NPZ actions are the commands submitted to env.step, not measured wheel angle/force after MetaDrive processing. Exact matching certifies submission, not a physical-response measurement.
normalized_action_mapping_scope.candidate_scope: Catalog candidates are already bounded post-MPPI sequences. Pre-clipping Gaussian draws were not archived, so clipping provenance cannot be reconstructed.
normalized_action_mapping_scope.action_order_static_audit: base_vehicle._set_action: action[0] steering, action[1] throttle/brake. _preprocess_action clips to [-1,1]. before_step currently uses _set_action, not incremental steering.
normalized_action_mapping_scope.steering_mapping: steering_command * vehicle.max_steering; actual branch-specific max_steering/wheel angles not saved.
normalized_action_mapping_scope.throttle_mapping: positive engine force with speed cap; negative with enable_reverse=False is brake force; not a linear SI acceleration mapping.
normalized_action_mapping_scope.runtime_dimension_or_sign_verification: Current source supports channel order; prior per-step actual vehicle controls were not recorded, so no claim of complete runtime SI mapping verification.
